raw.details:
BUILDFEST 2026 is a national-level student project showcase competition organized by Learnix Labs, providing students across India with an opportunity to showcase their innovative technology projects, gain recognition, and connect with fellow developers.

Whether you have completed a project or are currently developing one, bring your work into the spotlight!

Project Domains

Projects from all technology domains are welcome, including:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Web and App Development
  • Cybersecurity
  • Data Science and Analytics
  • Blockchain and Emerging Technologies
  • Open Source and Social Impact Solutions

Other innovative technical projects are also welcome.

Participation Process

  • Register: Sign up for BUILDFEST 2026 through Unstop.
  • Publish: Publish your project on the Learnix Labs Project Showcase at https://learnixlabs.in/project.
  • Prepare: Create a project abstract explaining the problem, solution, technologies used, key features, and real-world applications.
  • Submit: Submit your published Learnix Labs project URL and abstract through Unstop.
  • Share: Share your project with the community and receive support through valid upvotes.

Competition Format

  • Project submission through Unstop.
  • Project publishing through Learnix Labs.
  • Verification of eligible submissions.
  • Community voting through Learnix Labs.
  • Independent evaluation by the judging panel.
  • Final results and award announcements.

Community Choice Award

Awarded to the eligible project receiving the highest number of valid community upvotes during the official voting period.

Certificates and recognition will be provided as announced by the organizers.

Rules and Guidelines

  • Only projects published on Learnix Labs during the official submission period are eligible.
  • Both completed and ongoing projects are welcome.
  • Submission of the Learnix Labs project URL and abstract through Unstop is mandatory.
  • Projects must remain publicly accessible during evaluation and voting.
  • Plagiarism, copied submissions, and misleading information may result in disqualification.
  • Artificial engagement, duplicate accounts, and vote manipulation are strictly prohibited.
  • Incomplete or late submissions will not be considered.
  • Community voting will not influence judges' evaluation or rankings.
  • Organizers reserve the right to verify submissions and voting activity.
  • Judges' and organizers' decisions will be final.
